source.text: לְדָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמ֥וֹרנְאֻ֤ם יְהוָ֨ה׀לַֽאדֹנִ֗י שֵׁ֥ב לִֽימִינִ֑י עַד־אָשִׁ֥ית אֹ֝יְבֶ֗יךָ הֲדֹ֣ם לְרַגְלֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Of David. A psalm. [The] declaration of YHWH to my lord: Sit at my right [hand] until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.

en.L: Of David. A psalm. The declaration of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to my lord: "Sit at {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} right hand until I make {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} enemies a footstool for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} feet."
en.B: Of David. A psalm. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} declares to my lord: "Take {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} seat at {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} right hand, while I lay {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} enemies beneath {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} feet like a footstool."
en.R: By David. A song. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to my lord the king, "Sit here beside {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, at {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} right side, the place of honor. I will defeat {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} enemies and put them under {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} feet."

fr.L: De David. Un psaume. Déclaration {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} à mon seigneur : « Siège à {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} droite, jusqu’à ce que je fasse de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ennemis un marchepied pour {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} pieds. »
fr.B: De David. Un psaume. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare à mon seigneur : « Prends place à {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} droite, tandis que je mets {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ennemis sous {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} pieds comme un marchepied. »
fr.R: De David. Un chant. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit à mon seigneur le roi : « Assieds-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ici, près de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, à {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} droite, la place d’honneur. Je vaincrai {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ennemis et je les mettrai sous {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} pieds. »

sw.L: Ya Daudi. Zaburi. Tamko la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa bwana wangu: "Keti mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wa kuume mpaka niwafanye adui {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} kuwa kiti cha kuwekea miguu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}."
sw.B: Ya Daudi. Zaburi. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amwambia bwana wangu: "Keti mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wa kuume, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} niwaweke adui {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} chini ya miguu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kama kiti cha kuwekea miguu."
sw.R: Wimbo wa Daudi. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia bwana wangu mfalme, "Keti hapa kando {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, upande {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} wa kuume, mahali pa heshima. Nitawashinda adui {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} na kuwaweka chini ya miguu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}."

es.L: De David. Salmo. Declaración {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} a mi señor: «Siéntate a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} derecha hasta que yo ponga a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} enemigos por estrado de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} pies».
es.B: De David. Salmo. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} declara a mi señor: «Toma asiento a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} derecha, mientras yo pongo a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} enemigos bajo {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} pies como un estrado».
es.R: Canto de David. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a mi señor el rey: «Siéntate aquí junto a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} derecha, el lugar de honor. Yo derrotaré a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} enemigos y los pondré bajo {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} pies».

vi.L: Của Đa-vít. [Một] thi thiên. Lời tuyên phán của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} với chúa của tôi: "Hãy ngồi bên tay phải {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cho đến khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đặt các kẻ thù của {{deity_pronoun:con|Con}} làm bệ cho chân {{deity_pronoun:con|Con}}."
vi.B: Thi thiên của Đa-vít. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với chúa tôi: "Hãy ngồi bên phải {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, trong khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đặt các kẻ thù của {{deity_pronoun:con|Con}} dưới chân {{deity_pronoun:con|Con}} như cái bệ chân."
vi.R: Bài ca của Đa-vít. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với vua là chúa tôi: "Hãy ngồi đây bên cạnh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, bên phải {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, là chỗ danh dự. Ta sẽ đánh bại các kẻ thù của {{deity_pronoun:con|Con}} và đặt chúng dưới chân {{deity_pronoun:con|Con}}."

ko.L: 다윗의 시. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 주님께 선언하신 말씀: "내가 네 원수들을 네 발의 발판으로 삼을 때까지 내 오른쪽에 앉아 있어라."
ko.B: 다윗의 시. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 주님께 선언하신다. "내가 네 원수들을 발판처럼 네 발아래 둘 때까지 너는 내 오른쪽 자리에 앉아 있어라."
ko.R: 다윗이 지은 노래. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내 주님이신 왕께 말씀하셨다. "여기 내 곁에, 가장 영광스러운 자리인 내 오른쪽에 앉아 있어라. 내가 네 원수들을 물리쳐서 네 발아래에 두겠다."

pt.L: De Davi. Salmo. Declaração {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} ao meu senhor: "Senta-{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} à {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} direita, até que eu ponha os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} inimigos [como] estrado para os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} pés."
pt.B: De Davi. Salmo. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} declara ao meu senhor: "Ocupa o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} lugar à {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} direita, até que eu ponha os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} inimigos debaixo dos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} pés, como estrado."
pt.R: Canção de Davi. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} disse ao meu senhor, o rei: "Senta-{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} aqui ao {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} lado, à {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} direita, no lugar de honra. Eu vou derrotar os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} inimigos e colocá-los debaixo dos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} pés."

decisions.choice: The title shares verse 1
decisions.reason: This psalm's title is short and the Hebrew counts it together with the first line as verse 1, so here the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: declaration: a solemn word spoken by the LORD
decisions.reason: The word (ne'um) almost always introduces a word from God given through a prophet ("declares the LORD"). The psalm opens as a prophecy spoken to the king.

decisions.choice: my lord: the king, the psalmist's master
decisions.reason: The word ('adoni) is the ordinary way of addressing a superior, above all a king (1 Samuel 22:12; 1 Kings 1:13). The Hebrew text points it differently from 'Adonai, the title used for God in verse 5. The speaker, named in the title as David, calls the king "my lord"; Jesus asked how David could call his own descendant "lord" (Matthew 22:41-45).

decisions.choice: quoted of Jesus in the New Testament
decisions.reason: Jesus quotes this line in Matthew 22:44 (Mark 12:36; Luke 20:42-43), Peter in Acts 2:34-35, and Hebrews 1:13 applies it to the Son. It is the verse of the Old Testament the New Testament cites most often, and stands behind the confession that Christ is seated at God's right hand (Romans 8:34; Hebrews 1:3; 1 Corinthians 15:25).

decisions.choice: right hand, footstool: the seat of honor and the enemy beneath the feet
decisions.reason: The place at a king's right hand is the place of highest honor and shared rule (1 Kings 2:19). Victors set their feet on defeated enemies (Joshua 10:24), and Egyptian kings had their enemies pictured on their footstools.

decisions.choice: pronouns for the king follow the deity pronoun setting
decisions.reason: The psalm is an oracle to the king, whom the LORD seats at his right hand and makes a priest forever, and the New Testament applies it to Jesus (Matthew 22:44; Acts 2:34-35; Hebrews 1:13; 5:6). So, as with the king in Psalms 2 and 45, the pronouns for the king can be capitalized with the deity pronoun setting. "my lord" stays lowercase (m3).

decisions.choice: my lord the king
decisions.reason: Readable names the one addressed as the king (m3), so that "my lord" is not taken for God.

decisions.choice: the place of honor
decisions.reason: Readable explains what the right hand stands for (m5).

decisions.choice: the king's pronouns ("tu", "ton", "tes", "il") follow the deity_pronoun setting throughout Psalm 110, as the English does; "mon seigneur" stays lowercase
alternatives: no setting on the king's pronouns
decisions.reason: The English puts the king's pronouns under the setting because the New Testament reads this psalm of Jesus (meaning decision m4); French does the same, so that a reader who capitalises pronouns for God sees the same reading in both languages.

decisions.choice: the free pronouns for the king ("adui zako", "miguu yako") take the deity_pronoun span, as in the English
alternatives: no span on pronouns for the king
decisions.reason: The English lets the reader capitalise the pronouns for the king, since the New Testament reads this psalm of Jesus. Swahili follows it on the separate possessive words, the only pronouns it can capitalise; "bwana wangu" (my lord) stays lowercase, as the English "my lord" does.

decisions.choice: pronouns for the king in deity pronoun spans ({{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}})
decisions.reason: As in the English, and as in Psalms 2 and 45, the pronouns for the king whom the LORD seats at his right hand carry the deity pronoun setting, since the New Testament applies the psalm to Jesus. "mi señor" stays lowercase: it is the ordinary title for a king, not God's title "el Señor".

decisions.choice: mi señor
decisions.reason: The Hebrew ʾadoni is the way to address a master or king, written differently from ʾAdonai, the title of God in verse 5. Spanish keeps the small letter, and Readable adds "el rey", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: God calls the king "con", and the psalmist speaks to him as "ngài" (verses 2-3, 5), both with the deity_pronoun setting, as the English does for the king's pronouns
alternatives: no setting span for the king
decisions.reason: The English lets the reader capitalise the king's pronouns, because the New Testament reads the psalm of Jesus (see the meaning decision). God speaks to the king as "con", as in Psalm 2:7, and the poet addresses a king as "ngài", as in Psalm 45:3; each takes the setting so that the choice stays with the reader.

decisions.choice: "chúa của tôi" (L), "chúa tôi" (B, R) in lowercase for "my lord"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is the title a servant gives his master, here the king (see the meaning decision); a capital would make it God's title "Chúa", which the Hebrew does not have. Readable adds "vua" (the king), as the English Readable does. |

decisions.choice: "내 주님" for my lord ('adoni), and God speaks to him in 해라체 with "너", as in the Korean New Testament quotations of this verse (Matthew 22:44; Acts 2:34-35; Hebrews 1:13)
decisions.reason: "주" alone is the default of the divine name here, so the king, whom the speaker honours as his lord (meaning decision), is "주님" with "내"; the Korean of the Gospels and Acts already reads "주님께서 내 주님께", and the psalm keeps that link. God speaking uses 해라체 with 나 (style guide section 7a).

decisions.choice: The king is addressed as "너" in 해라체 through the psalm (verses 1-3, 5), as God addresses him in verses 1 and 4
alternatives: 합쇼체 from the speaker to his lord in verses 2-3 and 5
decisions.reason: The psalm is a prophetic word: what the speaker says to the king in verses 2-3 and 5 carries on the LORD's own charge ("rule!", meaning decision). One form of address keeps the oracle whole; a reviewer may prefer the honorific where the speaker, rather than God, is heard.

decisions.choice: Senta-te à minha direita, até que eu ponha os teus inimigos [como] estrado para os teus pés (L); Ocupa o teu lugar à minha direita ... debaixo dos teus pés, como estrado (B)
alternatives: a wording of the psalm's own
decisions.reason: Jesus, Peter and Hebrews quote this line (m4), so the Portuguese keeps the words of Matthew 22:44, Acts 2:34-35, Luke 20:42-43 and Hebrews 1:13 at each level where the Hebrew allows: Literal as Acts 2:35, Balanced as Luke 20:43, Readable "Senta-te aqui ao meu lado, à minha direita, no lugar de honra" as Hebrews 1:13 and Luke 20:42.

decisions.choice: ao meu senhor (lowercase); tu and the king's pronouns under the deity_pronoun setting
alternatives: ao meu Senhor (as the New Testament)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "my lord" is the ordinary address to a king (m3), so the psalm writes "senhor" in lowercase, as the English does; the Gospels and Acts, reading it of Jesus, write "meu Senhor", and the meaning note gives that reading. The LORD speaks to the king with "tu", and every pronoun for him takes the deity_pronoun span, as in the English (r-en-1).

source.text: מַטֵּֽה־עֻזְּךָ֗ יִשְׁלַ֣ח יְ֭הוָה מִצִּיּ֑וֹן רְ֝דֵ֗ה בְּקֶ֣רֶב אֹיְבֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] staff of your strength will send out YHWH from Zion; rule in [the] midst of your enemies.

en.L: The scepter of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} strength {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will send out from Zion: rule in the midst of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} enemies!
en.B: From Zion {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will stretch out the scepter of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} power: rule where {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} enemies surround {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}!
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will make {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} power as king reach out from Zion, Jerusalem. Rule over the enemies all around {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}!

fr.L: Le sceptre de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} puissance, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’enverra de Sion : domine au milieu de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ennemis !
fr.B: De Sion, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} étendra le sceptre de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} puissance : règne là où {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ennemis {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}entourent !
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fera s’étendre depuis Sion, Jérusalem, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} pouvoir de roi. Règne sur les ennemis qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}entourent !

sw.L: Fimbo ya nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataituma kutoka Sayuni: tawala katikati ya adui {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}!
sw.B: Kutoka Sayuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atainyoosha fimbo ya enzi ya uweza {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}: tawala katikati ya adui {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} wanaokuzunguka!
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atafanya nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} za kifalme zifike mbali kutoka Sayuni, Yerusalemu. Tawala juu ya adui wanaokuzunguka pande zote!

es.L: El cetro de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} poder lo enviará {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} desde Sion: ¡domina en medio de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} enemigos!
es.B: Desde Sion {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} extenderá el cetro de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} poder: ¡gobierna donde {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} enemigos {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rodean!
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hará que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} poder como rey se extienda desde Sion, Jerusalén. ¡Gobierna sobre los enemigos que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rodean!

vi.L: Cây quyền trượng của sức mạnh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ đưa ra từ Si-ôn: hãy cai trị giữa các kẻ thù của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!
vi.B: Từ Si-ôn, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ vươn cây quyền trượng uy lực của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra: hãy cai trị ngay giữa vòng vây kẻ thù của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ làm cho quyền lực vương giả của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vươn ra từ Si-ôn, tức Giê-ru-sa-lem. Hãy cai trị các kẻ thù vây quanh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!

ko.L: 네 힘의 홀을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시온에서 내보내실 것이다. 네 원수들 가운데서 다스려라!
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시온에서 네 권능의 홀을 뻗치실 것이다. 원수들에게 둘러싸인 그곳에서 다스려라!
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시온, 곧 예루살렘에서부터 왕인 너의 힘이 멀리까지 미치게 하실 것이다. 너를 둘러싼 원수들을 다스려라!

pt.L: O cetro da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} força {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} enviará de Sião: domina no meio dos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} inimigos!
pt.B: De Sião {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} estenderá o cetro do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} poder: governa no meio dos inimigos que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} cercam!
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai fazer o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} poder de rei se estender a partir de Sião, Jerusalém. Governa sobre os inimigos que estão ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} redor!

decisions.choice: staff: the scepter, a ruler's rod
decisions.reason: The word (matteh) is a staff or rod; held by a king it is the sign of his rule (Jeremiah 48:17). The LORD sends it out from Zion: he extends the king's rule beyond his city.

decisions.choice: rule: a command that is also a promise
decisions.reason: The command "rule!" is addressed to the king; it is the LORD's charge to him, as "Sit" was in verse 1. He will rule even while enemies still surround him.

decisions.choice: pronouns for the king follow the deity pronoun setting
decisions.reason: As in 110:1.

decisions.choice: your power as king
decisions.reason: Readable says what the scepter stands for (m1) and that Zion is Jerusalem.

source.text: עַמְּךָ֣ נְדָבֹת֮ בְּי֪וֹם חֵ֫ילֶ֥ךָ בְּֽהַדְרֵי־קֹ֭דֶשׁמֵרֶ֣חֶם מִשְׁחָ֑ר לְ֝ךָ֗ טַ֣ל יַלְדֻתֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Your people [are] freewill offerings on [the] day of your strength, in [the] splendors of holiness; from [the] womb of [the] dawn, to you [is the] dew of your youth.

en.L: Your people [are] freewill offerings on the day of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} strength, in the splendors of holiness; from the womb of the dawn, to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} [is] the dew of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} youth.
en.B: Your people offer themselves gladly on the day {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} march out in strength, in splendor and holiness. Out of the dawn's womb {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} youth comes to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} fresh as the dew.
en.R: On the day {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} go into battle, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people will gladly volunteer. They will come dressed in holy splendor. Your strength will stay young and fresh, like the dew that comes with each new morning.

fr.L: Ton peuple [est] offrandes volontaires au jour de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} puissance, dans les splendeurs de la sainteté ; du sein de l’aurore, à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} [est] la rosée de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} jeunesse.
fr.B: Ton peuple s’offre de bon cœur au jour où {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sors avec {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} force, dans la splendeur et la sainteté. Du sein de l’aurore, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} jeunesse vient à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, fraîche comme la rosée.
fr.R: Le jour où {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} partiras au combat, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple se portera volontaire avec joie. Ils viendront vêtus d’une sainte splendeur. Ta force restera jeune et fraîche, comme la rosée qui revient chaque matin.

sw.L: Watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} [ni] matoleo ya hiari siku ya nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, katika fahari za utakatifu; kutoka tumbo la alfajiri, {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}} [uko] umande wa ujana {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.B: Watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wanajitoa kwa hiari siku unapotoka kwa nguvu, katika fahari na utakatifu. Kutoka tumbo la alfajiri ujana {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} unakujia ukiwa safi kama umande.
sw.R: Siku utakapokwenda vitani, watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} watajitolea kwa furaha. Watakuja wamevaa fahari takatifu. Nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} zitabaki changa na mpya, kama umande unaokuja kila asubuhi mpya.

es.L: Tu pueblo [será] ofrendas voluntarias en el día de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} poder, en esplendores de santidad; desde el seno de la aurora, para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} [es] el rocío de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} juventud.
es.B: Tu pueblo se ofrecerá con gusto el día en que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} salgas con poder, con esplendor y santidad. Del seno del alba {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} llega {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} juventud, fresca como el rocío.
es.R: El día en que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} vayas a la batalla, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo se ofrecerá con gusto. Vendrán vestidos con esplendor santo. Tu fuerza seguirá joven y fresca, como el rocío que llega con cada nueva mañana.

vi.L: Dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] những của lễ tự nguyện trong ngày sức mạnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, trong sự huy hoàng của sự thánh khiết; từ lòng của rạng đông, sương móc của tuổi trẻ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [thuộc] về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vui lòng dâng mình trong ngày {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} xuất quân với sức mạnh, trong vẻ huy hoàng và thánh khiết. Từ lòng rạng đông, tuổi xuân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tươi mát như sương mai.
vi.R: Vào ngày {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ra trận, dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ vui lòng tình nguyện đi theo. Họ sẽ đến trong vẻ huy hoàng thánh khiết. Sức mạnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ luôn trẻ trung và tươi mới, như sương mai đến với mỗi buổi sáng.

ko.L: 네 힘의 날에 네 백성은 거룩함의 광채 가운데서 자원하는 예물[이 될 것이다]. 새벽의 태에서부터 네 젊음의 이슬이 네게 [있다].
ko.B: 네가 힘 있게 나아가는 날, 네 백성이 거룩한 광채 가운데서 기꺼이 자기를 드린다. 새벽의 태에서 네 젊음이 이슬처럼 싱그럽게 네게 온다.
ko.R: 네가 싸움터에 나가는 날, 네 백성은 기꺼이 자원하여 나설 것이다. 그들은 거룩한 광채를 입고 올 것이다. 아침마다 새로 내리는 이슬처럼 네 힘은 늘 젊고 싱싱할 것이다.

pt.L: O {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo [é] oferta voluntária no dia da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} força, em esplendores de santidade; do ventre da aurora, a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} [pertence] o orvalho da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} juventude.
pt.B: O {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo se oferece de boa vontade no dia em que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} marchas com força, em esplendor e santidade. Do ventre da aurora a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} juventude vem a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, fresca como o orvalho.
pt.R: No dia em que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fores para a batalha, o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} povo vai se apresentar de boa vontade. Eles virão vestidos de santo esplendor. A {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} força vai continuar jovem e fresca, como o orvalho que vem com cada nova manhã.

decisions.choice: freewill offerings: they give themselves willingly
decisions.reason: The word (nedavot) is used of gifts given freely, not by obligation. Here the people offer themselves, as the volunteers of Judges 5:2 and 5:9 did for battle.

decisions.choice: strength: power, and also an army
decisions.reason: The word (chayil) means strength and also the force that has it, an army. "The day of your strength" is the day the king marches out with his forces.

decisions.choice: in splendors of holiness: as in the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: The standard Hebrew text has "in splendors of holiness". Many Hebrew manuscripts and some ancient translations read a word that differs by one similar letter, "on the holy mountains" (as in 87:1). The renderings follow the standard text.

decisions.choice: the dew of your youth: as in the Hebrew text
alternatives: I have begotten you like the dew
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation, reading the same letters with other vowels, has "from the womb, before the morning star, I have begotten you", like 2:7. The renderings follow the Hebrew text. The whole verse is among the hardest in the Psalms.

decisions.choice: from the womb of the dawn ... the dew of your youth: fresh, renewed strength
alternatives: your young men come to you like dew
decisions.reason: Dew appears fresh each morning, born, as it were, from the dawn. The picture is of the king's youthful vigor, ever renewed; it may also mean his young warriors, many and fresh as the dew.

decisions.choice: pronouns for the king follow the deity pronoun setting
decisions.reason: As in 110:1.

decisions.choice: the day you go into battle
decisions.reason: Readable gives the likely sense of the phrase (m2).

decisions.choice: oferta voluntária
decisions.reason: The word is a gift freely given (m1); "oferta voluntária" is its name in the Portuguese of the Law, and Literal keeps it, with the people themselves as the offering. The singular reads better in Portuguese than the Hebrew plural.

source.text: נִשְׁבַּ֤ע יְהוָ֨ה׀וְלֹ֥א יִנָּחֵ֗ם אַתָּֽה־כֹהֵ֥ן לְעוֹלָ֑ם עַל־דִּ֝בְרָתִ֗י מַלְכִּי־צֶֽדֶק׃

records.literal_gloss: Has sworn YHWH and not will he relent: You [are] a priest forever according to [the] manner of Melchizedek.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has sworn and will not relent: "You [are] a priest forever according to the manner of Melchizedek."
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has taken an oath and will not take it back: "You are a priest for all time, after the pattern of Melchizedek."
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has made a solemn promise and will never change {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mind. He said, "You will always be a priest, the same kind of priest that Melchizedek was."

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a juré et ne se ravisera pas : « Tu [es] prêtre pour toujours à la manière de Melchisédek. »
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a prêté serment et ne reviendra pas sur {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} parole : « Tu es prêtre pour toujours, sur le modèle de Melchisédek. »
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait une promesse solennelle et ne changera jamais d’avis. Il a dit : « Tu seras toujours prêtre, le même genre de prêtre que Melchisédek. »

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameapa wala hatageuza nia: "Wewe [ni] kuhani milele kwa mfano wa Melkizedeki."
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameapa kiapo, wala hatakirudisha: "Wewe ni kuhani wa milele, kwa mfano wa Melkizedeki."
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameahidi kwa kiapo, wala hatabadili nia {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kamwe. Alisema, "Utakuwa kuhani daima, kuhani wa aina ileile aliyokuwa Melkizedeki."

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha jurado y no se retractará: «Tú [eres] sacerdote para siempre según la manera de Melquisedec».
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hecho un juramento y no lo retirará: «Tú eres sacerdote para siempre, a la manera de Melquisedec».
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha hecho una promesa solemne y nunca cambiará de parecer. Dijo: «Tú serás sacerdote para siempre, la misma clase de sacerdote que fue Melquisedec».

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã thề và sẽ không đổi ý: "Con [là] thầy tế lễ đời đời theo cách của Mên-chi-xê-đéc."
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã thề và sẽ không rút lại lời: "Con là thầy tế lễ đến muôn đời, theo khuôn mẫu Mên-chi-xê-đéc."
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã long trọng hứa và sẽ không bao giờ đổi ý. Ngài phán: "Con sẽ mãi mãi là thầy tế lễ, cùng một loại thầy tế lễ như Mên-chi-xê-đéc."

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 맹세하셨으니 뜻을 바꾸지 않으실 것이다. "너는 멜기세덱의 계열을 따라 영원히 제사장이다."
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 맹세하셨으니 그 맹세를 거두지 않으실 것이다. "너는 멜기세덱의 계열을 따른 영원한 제사장이다."
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 엄숙하게 약속하셨으니, 결코 마음을 바꾸지 않으실 것이다. 그분께서 말씀하셨다. "너는 영원히 제사장이 될 것이다. 멜기세덱과 같은 제사장이 될 것이다."

pt.L: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} jurou e não mudará de ideia: "Tu [és] sacerdote para sempre, segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque."
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} jurou e não voltará atrás: "Tu és sacerdote para sempre, da ordem de Melquisedeque."
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} fez um juramento, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nunca vai mudar de ideia. Ele disse: "Tu és sacerdote para sempre, o mesmo tipo de sacerdote que Melquisedeque foi."

decisions.choice: relent: change his mind, take back what he said
decisions.reason: The verb (nicham) is used of God changing course (Exodus 32:14). Here it is denied: the oath stands for good (Numbers 23:19).

decisions.choice: according to the manner of: after the pattern of
decisions.reason: The phrase ('al-divrati) can mean "according to the manner of" or "for the sake of". The ancient Greek translation, followed in Hebrews, has "according to the order of".

decisions.choice: Melchizedek: king of Salem and priest of God Most High
decisions.reason: Melchizedek, king of Salem (an old name for Jerusalem, 76:3), was priest of God Most High and blessed Abram (Genesis 14:18-20). In Israel kings were not priests (2 Chronicles 26:16-18); this king is both, in Melchizedek's line rather than Aaron's.

decisions.choice: applied to Jesus in Hebrews
decisions.reason: Hebrews quotes this oath of Jesus (Hebrews 5:6; 6:20; 7:17, 21) and argues from it that his priesthood is greater than Aaron's and lasts forever.

decisions.choice: He said
decisions.reason: Readable introduces the words of the oath.

decisions.choice: "Mên-chi-xê-đéc" for Melchizedek, the form of the Protestant tradition used in Hebrews
decisions.reason: The name keeps the form readers know from the New Testament, where Hebrews quotes this verse. |

decisions.choice: "멜기세덱의 계열을 따라" (L), "...계열을 따른" (B), "멜기세덱과 같은 제사장" (R)
decisions.reason: The Korean of Hebrews 5:6, which quotes this oath, says "계열"; the psalm keeps it so the two read alike. "반차" is the older word and no longer understood. Readable says what the phrase means, a priest of the same kind (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: Tu [és] sacerdote para sempre, segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque (L); da ordem de Melquisedeque (B); o mesmo tipo de sacerdote que Melquisedeque foi (R); jurou e não mudará de ideia (L) / não voltará atrás (B)
decisions.reason: Hebrews quotes this oath of Jesus (m4: Hebrews 5:6; 6:20; 7:17, 21), so the Portuguese keeps Hebrews' words at each level, which the Hebrew allows (m2): "ordem" renders "the manner of" as Hebrews' Greek does. Readable says "Tu és sacerdote para sempre" as Hebrews does, rather than the English Readable's "You will always be". "Melquisedeque" is spelled as in Genesis 14:18.

records.literal_gloss: [The] Lord at your right [hand] has shattered on [the] day of his anger kings.

en.L: The Lord at {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} right hand shatters kings on the day of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger.
en.B: The Lord stands at {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} right side, and when the day of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger comes, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} shatters kings.
en.R: The Lord is right beside {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, King. When the day comes for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to show {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will crush kings.

fr.L: Le Seigneur, à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} droite, brise des rois au jour de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère.
fr.B: Le Seigneur se tient à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} droite, et quand vient le jour de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} brise des rois.
fr.R: Le Seigneur est juste à côté de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, ô roi. Quand viendra le jour où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} montrera {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} écrasera des rois.

sw.L: Bwana aliye mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa kuume huwaponda wafalme siku ya hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Bwana yuko upande {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa kuume, na siku ya hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ikifika huwavunjavunja wafalme.
sw.R: Bwana yuko kando {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, Ee Mfalme. Siku itakapofika ya kuonyesha hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, atawaponda wafalme.

es.L: El Señor, a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} derecha, quebranta a reyes en el día de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira.
es.B: El Señor está a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} lado derecho, y cuando llegue el día de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hará pedazos a reyes.
es.R: El Señor está a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} lado, oh Rey. Cuando llegue el día en que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} muestre {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} aplastará a reyes.

vi.L: Chúa ở bên tay phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đập tan các vua trong ngày cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Chúa đứng bên phải {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và khi ngày cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đập tan các vua.
vi.R: Thưa vua, Chúa ở ngay bên cạnh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Khi đến ngày {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tỏ cơn giận, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ nghiền nát các vua.

ko.L: 네 오른쪽에 [계신] 주님께서 그분의 진노의 날에 왕들을 쳐부수신다.
ko.B: 주님께서 네 오른편에 서 계시니, 그분의 진노의 날이 오면 왕들을 쳐부수신다.
ko.R: 왕이여, 주님께서 바로 네 곁에 계신다. 그분께서 진노를 보이실 날이 오면 왕들을 무찌르실 것이다.

pt.L: O Senhor, à {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} direita, despedaça reis no dia da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira.
pt.B: O Senhor está ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} lado direito e, quando chegar o dia da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} despedaçará reis.
pt.R: O Senhor está bem ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} lado, ó Rei. Quando chegar o dia de {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} mostrar a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vai esmagar reis.

decisions.choice: the Lord at your right hand: God beside the king
alternatives: my lord (the king) at your right hand, LORD
decisions.reason: The speaker now addresses the king again: the Lord stands at his right side to defend him (16:8; 121:5), as the king sat at the LORD's right hand in verse 1. Some read the verse as addressed to the LORD, with "the Lord" meaning the king; but the Hebrew has the title used for God here, not the "my lord" of verse 1.

decisions.choice: has shattered: a future victory seen as done
decisions.reason: The verb is in the form for completed action, but it describes the coming "day of his anger": the victory is so certain that it is spoken of as done.

decisions.choice: anger: burning wrath against his enemies
decisions.reason: The word ('af) means nose, and so anger, from the flaring of the nostrils. Psalm 2:12 warns the kings of the earth of the same anger.

decisions.choice: pronouns for the king follow the deity pronoun setting
decisions.reason: As in 110:1.

decisions.choice: King
decisions.reason: Readable names the one addressed, since the pronouns change from the LORD to the king.

decisions.choice: "Chúa" for Adonai, capitalised, beside "chúa tôi" for the king in verse 1
decisions.reason: The Lord here is God beside the king (see the meaning decision); Adonai is "Chúa", not "CHÚA", as in Psalm 2:4. |

source.text: יָדִ֣ין בַּ֭גּוֹיִם מָלֵ֣א גְוִיּ֑וֹת מָ֥חַץ רֹ֝֗אשׁ עַל־אֶ֥רֶץ רַבָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: He judges among the nations, [it] is full [of] corpses; he shatters [the] head over [the] wide land.

en.L: He judges among the nations, [the land] is full [of] corpses; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} shatters [the] head over [the] wide land.
en.B: He passes judgment on the nations, and the dead lie everywhere; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} crushes the leaders over the wide earth.
en.R: He will judge the nations. Dead bodies will lie everywhere. He will crush the leaders of the whole wide world.

fr.L: Il juge parmi les nations, [le pays] est plein [de] cadavres ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} brise [la] tête sur [la] vaste terre.
fr.B: Il exerce son jugement sur les nations, et les morts jonchent le sol ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} écrase les chefs sur toute l’étendue de la terre.
fr.R: Il jugera les nations. Il y aura des morts partout. Il écrasera les chefs du monde entier.

sw.L: Atahukumu kati ya mataifa, [nchi] imejaa maiti; ataponda kichwa juu ya nchi pana.
sw.B: Anayahukumu mataifa, na maiti wamelala kila mahali; anawaponda viongozi katika dunia pana.
sw.R: Atayahukumu mataifa. Maiti watalala kila mahali. Atawaponda viongozi wa dunia nzima.

es.L: Juzgará entre las naciones, [la tierra] estará llena [de] cadáveres; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quebrantará [la] cabeza sobre [la] vasta tierra.
es.B: Juzgará a las naciones, y habrá muertos por todas partes; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} aplastará a los jefes por toda la anchura de la tierra.
es.R: Él juzgará a las naciones. Habrá cadáveres por todas partes. Él aplastará a los líderes del mundo entero.

vi.L: Ngài xét đoán giữa các dân tộc, [đất] đầy [những] thây xác; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đập tan đầu trên [khắp] đất rộng.
vi.B: Ngài phán xét các dân tộc, và xác chết nằm khắp nơi; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nghiền nát các thủ lĩnh trên khắp đất rộng.
vi.R: Ngài sẽ xét xử các dân tộc. Xác chết sẽ nằm khắp nơi. Ngài sẽ nghiền nát những kẻ cầm đầu trên khắp thế giới rộng lớn.

ko.L: 그분께서 민족들 가운데서 심판하시니, [그 땅이] 시체로 가득하고, 그분께서 넓은 땅 위의 머리를 쳐부수신다.
ko.B: 그분께서 민족들을 심판하시니, 죽은 자들이 곳곳에 널려 있다. 그분께서 넓은 땅의 우두머리들을 쳐부수신다.
ko.R: 그분께서 민족들을 심판하실 것이다. 시체들이 곳곳에 널릴 것이다. 그분께서 온 넓은 세상의 지도자들을 무찌르실 것이다.

pt.L: Ele julga entre as nações, [a terra] está cheia [de] cadáveres; {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} despedaça [a] cabeça sobre [a] vasta terra.
pt.B: Ele executa julgamento sobre as nações, e os mortos ficam espalhados por toda parte; {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} esmaga os líderes por toda a vasta terra.
pt.R: Ele vai julgar as nações. Haverá cadáveres por toda parte. Ele vai esmagar os líderes do mundo inteiro.

decisions.choice: he: the Lord of verse 5, or the king
decisions.reason: The subject is most likely the Lord of verse 5, who judges and shatters. The king may also be meant, as the one through whom the Lord acts; the psalm does not separate the two.

decisions.choice: full of corpses: the battlefield covered with the dead
decisions.reason: The verb (male') can mean "is full" or "fills"; either way the picture is of a battlefield after the LORD's judgment.

decisions.choice: head: the ruler, or the leaders
decisions.reason: The word (rosh) is singular: it can be the chief ruler of the enemy or stand for all the leaders, and it echoes the shattered heads of 68:22. Verse 7 plays on it: the king lifts up his own head.

decisions.choice: pronouns for the king follow the deity pronoun setting
decisions.reason: As in 110:1.

decisions.choice: the leaders
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable take the singular as standing for the enemy's leaders (m3).

source.text: מִ֭נַּחַל בַּדֶּ֣רֶךְ יִשְׁתֶּ֑ה עַל־כֵּ֝֗ן יָרִ֥ים רֹֽאשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: From a brook on the way he drinks; therefore he lifts up [the] head.

en.L: From a brook on the way {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} drinks; therefore {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} lifts up [{{deity_pronoun:his|His}}] head.
en.B: On the way {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} drinks from a stream, and so {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} stands with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} head held high.
en.R: He will stop to drink from a stream beside the road. Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will rise up, strong and victorious.

fr.L: Au torrent, en chemin, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} boit ; c’est pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lève [la] tête.
fr.B: En chemin, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} boit à un torrent, et ainsi {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se tient la tête haute.
fr.R: Il s’arrêtera pour boire à un ruisseau au bord du chemin. Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} se relèvera, fort et victorieux.

sw.L: Atakunywa kutoka kijito njiani; kwa hiyo atainua kichwa [{{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}}].
sw.B: Njiani anakunywa maji ya kijito, hivyo anasimama na kichwa {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} kimeinuliwa juu.
sw.R: Atasimama kunywa maji ya kijito kando ya njia. Kisha atainuka, mwenye nguvu na mshindi.

es.L: Del arroyo en el camino {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} beberá; por eso {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} levantará [{{deity_pronoun:su|Su}}] cabeza.
es.B: En el camino {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} beberá de un arroyo, y así {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} estará de pie con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} cabeza en alto.
es.R: Se detendrá a beber de un arroyo junto al camino. Después {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se levantará, fuerte y victorioso.

vi.L: Từ dòng suối bên đường {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} uống; vì thế {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngẩng [đầu] lên.
vi.B: Dọc đường {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} uống nước từ dòng suối, và vì thế {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đứng ngẩng cao đầu.
vi.R: Ngài sẽ dừng lại uống nước từ dòng suối bên đường. Rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ đứng lên, mạnh mẽ và chiến thắng.

ko.L: 그가 길가 시냇물에서 마시니, 그러므로 그가 [그의] 머리를 든다.
ko.B: 그는 길을 가다가 시냇물을 마시고, 그래서 머리를 높이 들고 선다.
ko.R: 그는 길가의 시냇물을 마시고 쉴 것이다. 그런 다음 힘차게 일어나 승리할 것이다.

pt.L: Da torrente no caminho {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} bebe; por isso {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} levanta [a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}}] cabeça.
pt.B: No caminho {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} bebe de um riacho, e por isso {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} mantém a cabeça erguida.
pt.R: Ele vai parar para beber de um riacho à beira do caminho. Depois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vai se levantar, forte e vitorioso.

decisions.choice: he: the king
decisions.reason: The one who drinks is most naturally the king, pursuing the enemy and refreshed on the way, as Samson was (Judges 15:18-19).

decisions.choice: lifts up the head: stands in triumph and honor
decisions.reason: To lift the head is to be victorious and restored (3:4; 27:6). The enemy's head is shattered (verse 6); the king's is lifted.

decisions.choice: pronouns for the king follow the deity pronoun setting
decisions.reason: As in 110:1.

decisions.choice: rise up, strong and victorious
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom (m2).

decisions.choice: "그" (plain) for the one who drinks, the king
decisions.reason: Korean must choose between the honorific "그분" (the Lord) and plain "그" (the king), where English can leave "he" open. The meaning decision takes the king as the one who drinks; the Lord of verses 5-6 keeps "그분".
